Michael Carrick Insists He Remains Manchester United Manager Despite Chelsea Defeat

01 Nov 2026, 10:42 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Sports Desk · Source: www.theguardian.com

2 min read

Manchester United’s Winless Run Reaches Nine Games

Following a 2-0 defeat away to Chelsea on Saturday, Manchester United manager Michael Carrick stated that he expects to remain in charge for the team's upcoming Champions League fixture against Roma on Tuesday. The loss extended United's winless run to nine games, marking the club's worst such streak since 1988.

Match Summary and Key Incidents

According to post-match reports, United performed well in the first half but failed to capitalize on multiple scoring opportunities. The match shifted in the second half:

  • First Goal: Chelsea's Morgan Rogers broke through the central defense to open the scoring.
  • Red Card: Lisandro Martínez was sent off following a foul in the box.
  • Second Goal: Cole Palmer converted the subsequent penalty kick to secure a 2-0 victory for Chelsea.

When asked about Martínez's dismissal, Carrick avoided criticizing the experienced defender, noting only that losing a player at that stage significantly influenced the outcome.

Relegation Concerns and Moving Forward

Prior to the evening fixtures, United sat just above the Premier League's bottom three. When questioned about the possibility of dropping into the relegation zone and whether the squad is prepared for a relegation battle, Carrick emphasized the need to focus on winning matches.

“You can look at it like that, and you can look at how far you can move up the league quite quickly if you win football matches,” Carrick said. “That’s the way it’s got to be approached.”

Chelsea Perspective

Chelsea manager Xabi Alonso praised his side's second-half reaction following a competitive opening period. Alonso also highlighted the performance of Brazil winger Estêvão Willian, who sparkled during his first league start of the season.

How to Verify
